subject: Sustainability & Supplier Diversity: Onboarding Questionnaire and PO setup
messages:
From: Sabrina Holt <sabrina.holt@bluecedarlogistics.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@bluecedarlogistics.com
Date: Sat, 10 May 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Supplier onboarding: initial ESG and diversity questionnaire

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the quick intro call yesterday. As discussed, BlueCedar Logistics is excited to start the vendor onboarding process with Redwood Inference. I attached our standard supplier packet and an initial ESG questionnaire so your procurement team can evaluate our policies.

Quick context: BlueCedar is a regional 3PL that also provides managed packaging and reverse logistics. We are minority-owned and have an active supplier-diversity certification with the State of California. To help move the PO setup along, could you confirm the following items and the expected turnaround?

- Preferred vendor intake form (PDF or Doc) that we should complete and return
- Contact for bank-account verification and how we should submit ACH details
- Any additional sustainability documentation you require (modern slavery statement, carbon footprint summary, certifications)
- PO terms and lead times for initial shipments once the vendor record is created

Attachments: [Attachment: BC_ESG_Questionnaire_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 210KB)], [Attachment: BlueCedar_W9.pdf (application/pdf, 60KB)]

We aim to have everything back to you within 3 business days. Happy to jump on a 15-minute slot if that helps.

Best,
Sabrina Holt
Head of Compliance & Partnerships
BlueCedar Logistics
Sabrina.Holt@bluecedarlogistics.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding: initial ESG and diversity questionnaire

Hi Sabrina — thanks for sending these over and for the clear checklist.

Short answers and next steps:

- Vendor intake form: Please complete the Redwood Vendor Intake (attached) and return to me. I have also pasted a short procurement checklist below for visibility.
- Bank/ACH: We use a secure vendor portal for bank verification. Naomi will send the portal link and instructions once the vendor record is initiated.
- Sustainability docs: The ESG questionnaire is perfect — we generally need a modern slavery statement (if available), any third-party certifications, and the completed questionnaire.
- PO terms: Standard initial PO is net 30 unless negotiated; for logistics vendors we can discuss staged payment terms at contract review.

Can you send the completed questionnaire + W9 back to me by end of day Weds (14 May)? If you need more time, indicate a date and we will accommodate.

Attachments: [Attachment: Redwood_Vendor_Intake_Form.pdf (application/pdf, 142KB)]

Procurement onboarding checklist (high level):
- Confirm legal entity name and tax id
- Receive W9 / tax docs
- Complete ESG & supplier diversity questionnaire
- Record minority/Small/DBE status and upload certificates
- Bank verification via vendor portal (ACH form)
- Create vendor record and issue PO

Looping in Naomi for portal/verification and Dev on contract/legal routing.

Thanks — I’ll track this in HubSpot and assign the procurement task.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Sun, 11 May 2025 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: BlueCedar onboarding — checklist and special notes

Team — tagging you both to start vendor setup work for BlueCedar (HubSpot record/Deal DC-2025-0487). Sabrina sent ESG questionnaire and W9 this morning. Items I need you to run/check: 

1) Supplier diversity classification: Sabrina says minority-owned. Please request a copy of their certification (state or third-party). If certified, flag for preferred-supplier routing.
2) Modern slavery / human trafficking: Review their questionnaire responses. If any 'no' or 'unknown' responses, add to review queue and escalate to legal.
3) Tax/bank: Naomi — set up the secure vendor portal link to collect ACH; confirm EIN from W9 (attach stub in record).
4) PO terms & contract: Dev — confirm whether we need an SOW or standalone services agreement for logistics. If SOW, ask legal for the template; otherwise run a standard services contract with net-30 terms.
5) Risk & sustainability: Add a note to the vendor profile if they have a recent sustainability report or emissions baseline.

I've attached a quick onboarding checklist and marked the high-priority items. Please update the HubSpot deal with progress and the DocuSign envelope link when you send any contract. Aim to have vendor record created and a preliminary PO ready by 2025-05-15.

Attachments: [Attachment: Procurement_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 28KB)]

Thanks — LMK if any blockers.

— Monica
From: Sabrina Holt <sabrina.holt@bluecedarlogistics.com>

Cc: accounts-payable@bluecedarlogistics.com
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding: initial ESG and diversity questionnaire

Monica — thanks for the clear next steps. We completed the ESG questionnaire and attached it here. A few quick notes:

- Supplier diversity: BlueCedar is certified as minority-owned (CA MBE) — certificate attached.
- Modern slavery: We have a published modern slavery statement on our website; I included the section reference in the questionnaire.
- Bank details and EIN: EIN is 12-3456789 (on W9). For ACH setup, we will load bank details into your portal once you send the secure link.
- Timeline: We can return the portal and any additional forms within 24 hours of receiving the link.

Attachments: [Attachment: BC_Completed_ESG.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 96KB)], [Attachment: BlueCedar_MBE_Cert.pdf (application/pdf, 110KB)]

Looking forward to partnering — let me know if you need a vendor risk questionnaire or compliance attestation.

Best,
Sabrina
Head of Compliance & Partnerships
BlueCedar Logistics
